spec.name: Earnings drift v19
spec.notes: Post-earnings drift on the reported surprise.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.9, annual return 7%, maximum drawdown 4%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a lag of 0, which introduces lookahead bias as earnings data is not available at the exact moment of market open without accounting for reporting times. Furthermore, the research log indicates a very small sample of trials (n=4), suggesting the strategy may be the result of data mining or a lucky period rather than a robust edge. The Sharpe ratio of 1.9 is likely inflated by these methodological flaws. I recommend paper trading to verify if the signal holds up in real-time conditions without lookahead bias and to ensure the transaction cost assumptions (8 bps) are realistic for the chosen universe.
